mapper.select: select *, (select me_name from member where me_num = cl_tc_me_num)as me_name from class where cl_able="요청";

SELECT c.cl_num, c.cl_title, c.cl_item, c.cl_intro, c.cl_money, c.cl_date, c.cl_level, c.cl_able, c.cl_tc_me_num, m.me_name, s.sc_name FROM class c JOIN subcategory s ON s.sc_cl_num = c.cl_num JOIN member m ON c.cl_tc_me_num = m.me_num WHERE s.sc_ca_num = #{ca_num} and CL_ABLE="Y"
